title: Capture of Erivan
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Erivan", at revision 1379522582, opens: "The capture of Erivan took place on 1 October 1827, during the Russo-Persian War of 1826–1828. The city fell to the Russians after being besieged for a week and opened up the path for the eventual capture of Tabriz, the second largest city in Iran and an important trading post." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4110457, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1827 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
